task: Implement deploy_service for the Kubernetes deployment without importing VM deploy logic.

candidate_memories.content: Kubernetes deploy_service applies a Helm chart and waits for the rollout to reach healthy status.
K8s deployments are declarative; the function must not manage instance lifecycles imperatively.
Deploy success is confirmed by checking the deployment rollout status via the K8s API.
When deploy_service spans k8s and VM environments, confirm the declarative vs imperative model.
VM deploy: deploy_service SSHs into each target host, runs the install script, and restarts the daemon.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: VM imperative SSH deploy is incompatible with declarative Kubernetes deployments

candidate_memories.content: Old ops note says deployment behavior should be abstracted so the same code runs on VMs and k8s.
